verdict.rationale: Token2's fido2-manage tool explicitly supports SSH security keys (generate, list resident, download/rehydrate, ssh-copy-id, add to local ssh-agent), directly evidencing FIDO2 sk-ssh hardware-backed key workflows. PIV is also supported via the Windows miniDriver and Companion App for smartcard-based certificate enrollment, but there is no mention of OpenPGP support for SSH auth. missing for 10: OpenPGP-based SSH key support, independent/hands-on verification of the sk-ssh workflow, and cross-platform PIV parity beyond Windows/macOS.
